actors.description: Locally authenticated fan with account-scoped preferences and mutations.

out_of_scope: Production email delivery; password recovery terminates in the local outbox.
Third-party ticket, blog, social, support, app-store and promoter effects; they terminate at branded local HTTP 200 soft-404 pages.
Orders, checkout and payments, which were not present in the frozen Songkick scope.
Tablet and mobile layouts; the repository brief freezes desktop 1440x900 only.
statement: Reproduce the frozen Songkick concert-discovery, entity-browsing, search, account, tracking and attendance experience as a faithful, fully local 1440x900 application with explicit first-party hard-404 and external soft-404 boundaries.
